Use the **AI assistance** panel for network to understand requests sent by your
website.

## Open the "AI assistance" panel

The **AI assistance** panel opens [in the drawer](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/console/reference#drawer).

![The AI assistance panel opened in its default state.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-default.png)

### From the Network panel

To open **AI assistance** from the [Network panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/network/overview),
right-click a request and select the **Ask AI** option.

![The request context menu with 'Ask AI' highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/network/open-context-menu.png)

When you open **AI assistance** like this, the selected network request is
pre-selected as context for the conversation.

Alternatively, click the floating button next to the network request that you hover over.

![The floating button attached to a network request.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/network/open-floating-button.png)

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** When opening **AI assistance** with the following methods, make sure to select [Conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/network#conversation_context) as outlined above.

### From the command menu

To open **AI assistance** from the command menu, type `AI` and then run the
**Show AI assistance** command, which has the **Drawer** badge next to it.

![The opened ommand menu with 'Show AI assistance' highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-command-menu.png)

### From the "More tools" menu

Alternatively, in the top right corner, select **More options** \> **More tools** \> **AI assistance**.

![The opened more tools menu.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-more-tools.png)

## Conversation context

Chats with **AI assistance** relate to the network request currently selected
in the **Network** panel request list. A reference to this request is shown in the
bottom left corner of the panel.

![The AI assistance panel with the context request highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/network/conversation-context.png)

Change context by clicking on another request in the **Network** panel.

**AI assistance** is using the request URL, headers, timings and the request
initiator chain to answer your questions.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Important:** headers that could contain sensitive information are automatically redacted.

Click the **Expand** button
in the `Analyzing network data` chip after starting a conversation to see the raw
data used by **AI assistance**.

![The AI assistance panel with the Analyzing network data chip highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/network/data-usage.png)

## Prompting

When starting a new conversation, **AI assistance** for network offers example
prompts to help you get started quickly.

![The AI assistance panel with the example prompts highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/network/example-prompts.png)

Click any of the prompts to prefill the prompt input field at the bottom of the
panel.

Alternatively, type your own prompt or question into the input field.

To send a prompt, either press `Enter` or click the arrow on the right hand
side of the input field.

### No answer given

**AI assistance** might not provide answers due to various reasons.

![The AI assistance panel with a refused conversation.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/answer-refused.png)

If you think your prompt is something **AI assistance** should be able to
discuss, [file a bug](https://goo.gle/devtools-bug).

### Conversation history

Once you start a conversation, every next answer is based on your previous
interactions between you and the AI.

AI assistance saves your conversation history between sessions, so you can access your previous chats even after DevTools or Chrome reload.

Use the controls in the top-left corner of the panel to control your conversation
history.

![The AI assistance panel with the history controls highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/history.png)

#### Start new

To start a new conversation with the currently selected
[conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/network#conversation_context), click the button.

#### Continue

To continue a past conversation, click the button and select it from the context menu.

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** [Conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/network#conversation_context) is not automatically updated as it might have vanished since the conversation stopped.

#### Delete

To delete a conversation from history, click the button.

## Rate answers and provide feedback

**AI assistance** is an experimental feature. Therefore we are actively looking
for your feedback to learn how we can improve answer quality and the overall
experience.

![The AI assistance panel with rating controls highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/rate-answers.png)

### Vote answers

Rate an answer using the
**Thumbs up** and
**Thumbs down** buttons below the answer.

### Report answers

To report inappropriate content, click the button next to the voting buttons.
